scope: Actual generated master and native 44x44 / 32x32 exports visually inspected against the current Dragonguard / Veteran Dragonguard masters and native portraits. Source candidate review only; no GUI, battle, UI rendering, final artistic approval or rights acceptance.
observations: The new icon removes the old pale Guardian tower shield and straight spear. The hooked silver polearm head with a blue inset and aged gold socket matches the current Veteran Dragonguard equipment.

The dark navy drake-scale mantle and navy tabard match the current material family. The ivory winged blade crest on folded cloth retains the official central silhouette in the master; fine feather detail reduces at 32 pixels.
Both native exports remain one compact polearm and mantle group against the established dark chestnut background. No words, frame, horse, cavalry, eagle, Guardian or shield are visible.
At 44 pixels, the weapon head, shaft and navy crest panel remain separate high contrast forms. At 32 pixels, the silhouette remains distinct from the old shield and spear icon.

One unchanged 1254x1254 RGB master from the built-in image tool produces both RGBA exports through the existing raster converter. No manual pixel painting, warping or unrecorded creative edits were used.
status: Source replacement prepared and selected recipes updated. Canonical assembly, stage publication and native acceptance remain with root.
